---
title: "Hazelnut price forecasting"
description: "Every forecasting method we tried against naive (the price stays where it is): the development scoreboard, calm and shock months, the holdout, ranges, crop estimates and the lira."
---

```{python}
from hazelnut.forecast.dataset import LIRA_CRISES, SHOCK_PERIODS
from hazelnut.site import charts
from hazelnut.site import page_helpers as ph
from hazelnut.site.config import SITE_DIR, load_crops
from hazelnut.site.labels import method_name

crop = load_crops()["hazelnut"]
res = SITE_DIR / "data" / crop.slug / "results"
manifest = ph.read_json_or_none(SITE_DIR / "data" / crop.slug / "manifest.json")
stamp = ph.as_of_stamp(manifest) if manifest is not None else None

dev = ph.read_csv_or_none(res / "scoreboard_dev.csv",
                          required=("method", "horizon", "n", "mae", "ratio"))
holdout = ph.read_csv_or_none(res / "scoreboard_holdout.csv",
                              required=("method", "horizon", "n", "ratio"))
shocks = ph.read_csv_or_none(res / "scoreboard_shocks.csv",
                             required=("method", "horizon", "period", "mae", "ratio"))
f3 = ph.read_csv_or_none(res / "forecast_3m.csv",
                         required=("target_month", "actual", "naive", "best_other",
                                   "best_other_method"))
ranges = ph.read_csv_or_none(res / "ranges.csv",
                             required=("method", "horizon", "cov80", "width80", "cov90", "skill"))
band = ph.read_csv_or_none(res / "range_band_3m.csv",
                           required=("target_month", "actual", "q10", "q90"))
check = ph.read_csv_or_none(res / "crop_check.csv",
                            required=("method", "horizon", "crop_source", "ratio"))
lira = ph.read_csv_or_none(res / "lira.csv",
                           required=("method", "horizon", "period", "mape_ratio", "mae_ratio",
                                     "dm_p"))

# Hazelnut-specific choices -------------------------------------------------------------
NOT_IN_MULTIPLE = ("season_reg",)  # its errors are already large in calm months
CROP_SOURCE = "giresun"            # the crop estimate the standard inputs use
RANGE_BASE = "naive_emp"           # the range the dashboard shows
BAND_HORIZON = 3                   # range_band_3m.csv / forecast_3m.csv
LIRA_TREND = "composed_fx_drift_36"
LIRA_TRENDS = {"composed_fx_drift_36": "FX drift, 36 m",
               "composed_fx_infl": "inflation rule"}
# The rows of the lira report's table, in its order (the sixth FX variant, spot + 12-month
# drift, is not in the report's table; it stays in results/lira.csv).
LIRA_NAMES = {
    "naive": "Lira naive",
    "try_drift_36": "Lira drift, 36 m",
    "try_drift_12": "Lira drift, 12 m",
    "composed_fx_drift_36": "USD naive × FX drift, 36 m",
    "composed_fx_drift_12": "USD naive × FX drift, 12 m",
    "composed_fx_infl": "USD naive × inflation gap",
    "composed_fx_spot": "USD naive × FX spot",
    "composed_fx_spot_drift_36": "USD naive × spot + drift, 36 m",
    "try_sarima": "SARIMA on lira",
    "try_lightgbm": "LightGBM on lira",
}

order = [m for m, _, _ in ph.scoreboard_rows(dev)] if dev is not None else None
RATIO3 = ph.fmt_ratio(3)
```

```{python}
parts = []
if dev is not None:
    others = dev[dev["method"] != ph.NAIVE]
    if (others["ratio"] >= 1).all():
        parts.append("Nothing we tried beat naive, the forecast that next month's price is "
                     "this month's, at 1, 3 or 6 months ahead in the development period.")
    else:
        parts.append(ph.dev_subtitle(dev))
if holdout is not None:
    winners = [n for m, n, r in ph.scoreboard_rows(holdout)
               if m != ph.NAIVE and all(v < 1 for v in r.values())]
    if not winners:
        parts.append("On the holdout (scored once, never tuned on) no method beat it at "
                     "every horizon.")
if shocks is not None:
    lo, hi = ph.shock_multiple(shocks, NOT_IN_MULTIPLE)
    parts.append(f"In supply shocks the errors grew {lo:.1f} to {hi:.1f} times, naive's included.")
if band is not None:
    share, _, _ = ph.band_held(band)
    parts.append(f"What can honestly be offered is a range: the spread of past moves gave an "
                 f"8-in-10 range that held {ph.fmt_pct(share)} of the time "
                 f"{BAND_HORIZON} months ahead.")
found = " ".join(parts) or "How the forecasting methods scored against naive."
ph.raw_html(ph.analysis_head_html(crop.name, "Forecasting",
                                  "Can anything beat \"the price stays where it is\"?",
                                  found, stamp))
```

```{=html}
<div class="sect analysis-sect"><div><span class="eyebrow">Point forecasts, USD</span><h2>The scoreboard</h2></div></div>
```

::: {.dash}

::: {#panel-dev .panel .span-6}
```{python}
TITLE = "Development period: error against naive"
if dev is None:
    ph.raw_html(ph.panel_head_html(TITLE, "Each method's error divided by naive's."))
    ph.raw_html(ph.unavailable_html())
else:
    ph.raw_html(ph.panel_head_html(TITLE, ph.dev_subtitle(dev)))
    ph.raw_html(ph.metric_table_html(dev, [("Error ÷ naive's", "ratio", RATIO3)],
                                     caption="Development-period error divided by naive's, "
                                             "by months ahead", order=order,
                                     methods_href="../../methods.qmd"))
    naive = dev[dev["method"] == ph.NAIVE].sort_values("horizon")
    ph.raw_html(
        '<p class="foot">Mean absolute error divided by naive\'s on the same forecasts; above '
        f"1 is worse. {ph.count_text(dev['n'])} monthly forecasts per horizon. Naive's own "
        f"error: {' / '.join(ph.fmt_usd(v) for v in naive['mae'])} per kg at "
        f"{' / '.join(str(int(h)) for h in naive['horizon'])} months.</p>"
    )
```
:::

::: {#panel-shocks .panel .span-6}
```{python}
TITLE = "Calm months against shock months"
if shocks is None:
    ph.raw_html(ph.panel_head_html(TITLE, "Error divided by naive's, in calm and shock months."))
    ph.raw_html(ph.unavailable_html())
else:
    ph.raw_html(ph.panel_head_html(TITLE, ph.shock_subtitle(shocks, NOT_IN_MULTIPLE)))
    ph.raw_html(ph.metric_table_html(
        ph.shock_table(shocks),
        [("Calm months", "calm", RATIO3), ("Shock months", "shock", RATIO3)],
        caption="Error divided by naive's in calm and shock months, by months ahead",
        order=order))
    ph.raw_html(
        f'<p class="foot">Shock periods by target month: {ph.shock_years_label(SHOCK_PERIODS)}. '
        "Each period is scored against naive on its own months. The season regression is "
        "left out of the error multiple above: its errors are already large in calm "
        "months.</p>"
    )
```
:::

::: {#panel-forecast-3m .panel .span-12}
```{python}
TITLE = f"{BAND_HORIZON} months ahead: forecasts against the price"
if f3 is None:
    ph.raw_html(ph.panel_head_html(TITLE, "Naive and the closest challenger against the actual price."))
    ph.raw_html(ph.unavailable_html())
else:
    other = method_name(str(f3["best_other_method"].iloc[0]))
    ph.raw_html(ph.panel_head_html(TITLE, ph.forecast_3m_subtitle(f3, BAND_HORIZON)))
    # Only the shock periods that start inside the chart's months are shaded.
    shaded = [s for s in SHOCK_PERIODS if s[0] <= str(f3["target_month"].max())]
    charts.show(charts.forecast_vs_actual(f3, other, shaded))
    ph.raw_html(
        f'<p class="foot">Development period, target months {ph.month_label(f3["target_month"].min())} '
        f"to {ph.month_label(f3['target_month'].max())}, USD per kg. {other} is the method "
        f"other than naive with the lowest {BAND_HORIZON}-month error. Both forecasts trail "
        "the turns. Shaded: supply shocks.</p>"
    )
```
:::

::: {#panel-holdout .panel .span-6}
```{python}
TITLE = "Holdout: scored once, never tuned on"
if holdout is None:
    ph.raw_html(ph.panel_head_html(TITLE, "The final holdout, scored once."))
    ph.raw_html(ph.unavailable_html())
else:
    ph.raw_html(ph.panel_head_html(TITLE, ph.holdout_subtitle(holdout)))
    ph.raw_html(ph.metric_table_html(holdout, [("Error ÷ naive's", "ratio", RATIO3)],
                                     caption="Holdout error divided by naive's, scored once, "
                                             "never tuned on", order=order))
    notes = []
    if dev is not None:
        notes.append(ph.holdout_dev_note(holdout, dev) or "")
    notes.append("Many of these months fall in the 2025 price spike, so one or two big misses "
                 "move every number: read it as a sanity check, not a new ranking.")
    ph.raw_html(f'<p class="foot">{ph.escape(" ".join(n for n in notes if n))}</p>')
```
:::

::: {#panel-crop-check .panel .span-6}
```{python}
TITLE = "Crop estimates: national instead of Giresun, and a month later"
if check is None or dev is None:
    ph.raw_html(ph.panel_head_html(TITLE, "Error divided by naive's with other crop inputs."))
    ph.raw_html(ph.unavailable_html())
else:
    ph.raw_html(ph.panel_head_html(TITLE, ph.crop_check_subtitle(
        dev, check, CROP_SOURCE, rule="the August rule")))
    ph.raw_html(ph.metric_table_html(
        ph.crop_check_table(dev, check, CROP_SOURCE), [("Error ÷ naive's", "ratio", RATIO3)],
        caption="Error divided by naive's with the crop estimate on time and a month late",
        row="row", names=lambda r: r, highlight=None, row_head="Method and crop input"))
    ph.raw_html(
        '<p class="foot">Development period. "On time" is the standard rule: a year\'s crop '
        'estimate is used from August of that year. "A month late" uses every estimate one '
        "month later (the 2018 Giresun estimate from November), to test that rule for a "
        "leak; the national rows use that late timing too, so they are not the report's main "
        "comparison. At the standard timing, the crop-estimate report found the national "
        "estimate worse than Giresun's at every method and horizon.</p>"
    )
```
:::

::: {#panel-band .panel .span-7}
```{python}
TITLE = f"The 8-in-10 range, {BAND_HORIZON} months ahead"
if band is None:
    ph.raw_html(ph.panel_head_html(TITLE, "The backtest's 8-in-10 range against the actual price."))
    ph.raw_html(ph.unavailable_html())
else:
    ph.raw_html(ph.panel_head_html(TITLE, ph.band_subtitle(band, SHOCK_PERIODS, BAND_HORIZON)))
    charts.show(charts.range_band(band))
    ph.raw_html(
        f'<p class="foot">{ph.escape(method_name(RANGE_BASE))}: the price {BAND_HORIZON} months '
        f"earlier times the 10th and 90th percentiles of all earlier {BAND_HORIZON}-month moves. "
        "Development period, USD per kg; marked months fell outside the range.</p>"
    )
```
:::

::: {#panel-ranges .panel .span-5}
```{python}
TITLE = "Range methods compared"
if ranges is None:
    ph.raw_html(ph.panel_head_html(TITLE, "Coverage, width and skill of each range method."))
    ph.raw_html(ph.unavailable_html())
else:
    ph.raw_html(ph.panel_head_html(TITLE, ph.ranges_subtitle(ranges, RANGE_BASE)))
    ph.raw_html(ph.metric_table_html(
        ranges,
        [("8 in 10 held", "cov80", ph.fmt_pct), ("9 in 10 held", "cov90", ph.fmt_pct),
         ("8-in-10 width", "width80", ph.fmt_usd), ("Skill", "skill", ph.fmt_signed)],
        caption="Range forecasts: coverage, width and skill by months ahead",
        order=ph.ranges_order(ranges, RANGE_BASE), highlight=RANGE_BASE))
    ph.raw_html(
        '<p class="foot">Held: share of months the actual price fell inside the range. '
        "Width: the average 8-in-10 range, USD per kg. "
        '<a href="../../methods.qmd#skill">Skill</a>: 1 minus the method\'s '
        '<a href="../../methods.qmd#pinball-loss">pinball loss</a> '
        "(averaged over five quantiles) divided by the first row's; above 0 would beat "
        "it. Development period.</p>"
    )
```
:::

::: {#panel-lira-split .panel .span-5}
```{python}
TITLE = "Last USD price × the lira's depreciation trend"
if lira is None:
    ph.raw_html(ph.panel_head_html(TITLE, "Error divided by lira naive's, crisis and calm months."))
    ph.raw_html(ph.unavailable_html())
else:
    ph.raw_html(ph.panel_head_html(TITLE, ph.lira_split_subtitle(lira, LIRA_TREND)))
    wide = ph.lira_split(lira, LIRA_TREND, ("calm", "crisis"))
    wide.columns = ["Calm months", "Lira crises"]
    charts.show(charts.ratio_bars(wide, highlight="Lira crises"))
    ph.raw_html(
        '<p class="foot"><a href="../../methods.qmd#mape">MAPE</a> divided by lira naive\'s, development period (36-month trend). '
        f"Lira crises: {ph.periods_label(LIRA_CRISES)}. This is the lira's own depreciation "
        "trend, in the 2018-24 crisis years, suggestive (6 variants tried); it is no "
        "hazelnut-market signal.</p>"
    )
```
:::

::: {#panel-lira .panel .span-7}
```{python}
TITLE = "Lira forecasts against lira naive"
if lira is None:
    ph.raw_html(ph.panel_head_html(TITLE, "Error divided by lira naive's, all months."))
    ph.raw_html(ph.unavailable_html())
else:
    # USD naive x FX variants tried; the gains are suggestive at most.
    n_fx = lira.loc[lira["method"].astype(str).str.startswith("composed_fx"), "method"].nunique()
    ph.raw_html(ph.panel_head_html(TITLE, ph.lira_subtitle(
        lira, list(LIRA_TRENDS), "the depreciation-trend forecasts",
        caveat=f"suggestive ({n_fx} variants tried)" if n_fx else "which is suggestive only")))
    allm = lira[(lira["period"] == "all") & lira["method"].isin(list(LIRA_NAMES))]
    ph.raw_html(ph.metric_table_html(
        allm, [("MAPE ÷ naive's", "mape_ratio", ph.fmt_ratio(2)),
               ("MAE ÷ naive's", "mae_ratio", ph.fmt_ratio(2))],
        caption="Lira forecasts: error divided by lira naive's, all months",
        names=LIRA_NAMES.get, order=list(LIRA_NAMES)))
    ph.raw_html(
        '<p class="foot">Development period, all months. MAPE is the fair measure here; MAE is '
        "dominated by the high-inflation years. "
        '<a href="../../methods.qmd#p-value">Diebold-Mariano test</a> on |log error| against '
        f"lira naive, all months: {ph.escape(ph.lira_p_note(lira, LIRA_TRENDS))} Six FX "
        "variants were tried, so treat p = 0.01 as suggestive, not conclusive; p-values for "
        "the calm or crisis months alone would be approximate (their months are not "
        "consecutive) and are not shown. The sixth variant, spot plus 12-month drift, is in "
        f'<a href="../../data/{crop.slug}/results/lira.csv">lira.csv</a>.</p>'
    )
```
